scripts.dev: npm run check:architecture && npm run build:native && quickgui dev
scripts.build: npm run check:architecture && npm run build:native && quickgui build
scripts.check: npm run check:architecture && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo check --workspace && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run check:architecture && npm run build:native && npm run test:architecture && cargo test -p electropic-core && tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.test:quickgui: npm run check:architecture && npm run build:native && quickgui test
scripts.smoke: npm run check:architecture && npm run build:native && tsx scripts/render-demo.ts
scripts.build:native: npm run check:architecture && napi build --manifest-path crates/electropic-native/Cargo.toml --package electropic-native --output-dir native --dts ../src/engine/native-api.d.ts --release && cargo run --quiet -p electropic-core --bin export_types && oxfmt --write src/engine/types.ts src/engine/native-api.d.ts
scripts.test:bun: npm run check:architecture && bun test tests/native.test.ts
